nodes.label: Webpack build config (admin/media/editor entries)
nodes.rationale: Extends @wordpress/scripts defaults so DependencyExtractionWebpackPlugin maps @wordpress/* imports to wp.* globals and writes build/*.asset.php for the PHP enqueue to read.

nodes.label: Uninstall routine
nodes.rationale: Removes plugin-owned data (tables, options, logs/temp dirs, cron hooks) but deliberately leaves the backup directory so an accidental uninstall cannot destroy original images.

nodes.label: Backups preserved on uninstall
nodes.rationale: omnio-image-optimizer/backup holds users' originals, often the only copy; rmdir only removes the parent when empty, and nothing globs into backup.

nodes.label: StoreSettings::register()
nodes.rationale: scan_frequency must be declared in the REST schema or core strips the key before sanitize() sees it and the setting silently never saves.

nodes.label: StatsResource::CACHE_KEY (omnio_io_stats transient)
nodes.rationale: Defined from OptimizationLog::STATS_CACHE_KEY so the writer that invalidates and the reader cannot drift onto different keys.

nodes.label: actions.php registration manifest
nodes.rationale: One readable list of everything that wires into WordPress, replacing eight service providers that each held only one or two lines. Required by Application::requireCommonFiles().

nodes.label: repair-mime then repair-backups then purge ordering
nodes.rationale: repair-backups must run before 'Delete all backups now' which removes exactly what it recovers; repair-mime must run before repair-backups since a repaired row is what makes it visible to that pass.
nodes.norm_label: repair-mime then repair-backups then purge ordering

nodes.label: ActivationHandler::activateSite()
nodes.rationale: Kicks a first scan so the dashboard has real figures; ScanRunner constructed directly because activation can fire before container bindings exist.

nodes.label: MediaLibraryHandler::optimization_payload()
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for an attachment's optimization state, shared by the classic media modal and the REST field so they never drift; treats an 'optimized' row whose file is missing as not optimized.

nodes.label: MenuHandler::enqueue()
nodes.rationale: Reads (never starts) the scan snapshot since enqueue runs on every page load; versions CSS by mtime because the generated asset hash tracks JS only.

nodes.label: NoticeHandler::is_relevant_screen()
nodes.rationale: Limited to upload, plugins and the plugin's own page instead of every admin screen, mirroring the plugin's objection to other plugins' noisy notices.

nodes.label: JobRunner::purge_manifests()
nodes.rationale: Ignores expiry and status filters: backup_expires=0 (keep forever) rows would never match the expiry query, and rows moved off optimized still own their files.

nodes.label: JobRunner::purge_rows()
nodes.rationale: Keeps status 'optimized' so the image still counts toward savings; an empty backup_path is what marks it unrestorable.

nodes.label: ScanJobRunner::unschedule_batch()
nodes.rationale: Uses one-read-one-write wp_unschedule_hook because the cron option is lock-free last-write-wins; an unschedule/ask-again loop can spin forever against a concurrent re-arming racer.

nodes.label: BackupController::MAX_BATCHES (500)
nodes.rationale: Bounds the batched loops so a row that refuses to clear cannot re-select itself forever inside one HTTP request.

nodes.label: BackupController::purge()
nodes.rationale: Two passes: manifest purge clears rows and named files, then purge_orphans sweeps unreferenced files so the folder is actually empty; bytes freed measured from the directory.

nodes.label: BulkController::start()
nodes.rationale: start() is idempotent so a second tab clicking Start cannot reset a mid-flight run; `fresh` discards progress.

nodes.label: BulkController::cancel()
nodes.rationale: Cancels through the coordinator so a chained run does not leave its closing scan queued.

nodes.label: BulkController::run()
nodes.rationale: Full run = measure, optimize, measure again, so every dashboard number was counted against the disk rather than stale log-table claims.

nodes.label: BulkController::phase()
nodes.rationale: Scan state, run state and snapshot returned together so ring, progress bar and tiles cannot disagree.

nodes.label: LogController::download()
nodes.rationale: Streams the file via readfile and exits instead of returning JSON: log can be 10MB and base64 in JSON would be larger; exit stops the REST server appending a body.

nodes.label: OptimizeController::restore()
nodes.rationale: Reports a non-zero `ambiguous` count when some references could not be reversed - saying so plainly beats a silent half-result.

nodes.label: OptimizeController::requeue()
nodes.rationale: Deleting the log row is what returns an attachment to the pending queue; Scanner treats absence of a terminal row as outstanding.

nodes.label: OptimizeController::rescan()
nodes.rationale: For libraries whose DB and uploads were restored from different points in time: drops `optimized` rows whose file is missing.

nodes.label: OptimizeController::reconcileMime()
nodes.rationale: Repair half of the Interceptor guard for stale post_mime_type; must run before 'Repair backups'. Bounded by MAX_BATCHES because its query filters on the column it rewrites.

nodes.label: ScanController::start()
nodes.rationale: `force` restarts a stalled scan but never overrides the bulk-active guard; the bulk-active error is returned verbatim so the dashboard can explain it.

nodes.label: api.php (omnio-image-optimizer/v1 routes)
nodes.rationale: URLs are load-bearing: the admin bundle calls them by path, so renames break cached builds; bulk/status and phase accept GET and POST for that reason; library/ prefix avoids clashing with legacy top-level `scan`.

nodes.label: BackupManager::reconcile()
nodes.rationale: Driven from log rows, not a directory walk (a directory-started glob once destroyed 54 real backups); only writes pointers, so must run before purge_orphans() and never after.

nodes.label: BackupManager::purge_orphans()
nodes.rationale: Only regular files inside root, keeps index.php/.htaccess, only caller is the typed-confirmation admin action; cron must never reach it.

nodes.label: Bounded cursor batch loop (MAX_BATCHES)
nodes.rationale: Repair queries filter on the very column they rewrite, so forward progress is guaranteed by the cursor (last_id), and MAX_BATCHES=500 stops an unresolvable row re-selecting itself forever within one HTTP request.

nodes.label: Repair before destroy (reconcile before purge)
nodes.rationale: Purge sweeps exactly the unreferenced backup files reconcile would recover, so reconcile is ordered first in routes and UI; mime reconcile precedes backup repair.

nodes.label: Coordinator phase WEIGHTS (10/80/10)
nodes.rationale: Scans are quick relative to conversion; weighting prevents the progress bar sitting at zero through optimize then leaping, which reads as a stall.

nodes.label: Invariant 22: a status column is not evidence the file exists
nodes.norm_label: invariant 22: a status column is not evidence the file exists

nodes.label: Admin SPA mount view
nodes.rationale: Only markup PHP emits for the React admin. .wp-header-end is load-bearing: without it WordPress moves admin notices inside the React masthead's h1; foreign notices are stripped by ForeignNoticeHandler.

nodes.label: Media Library optimization column cell
nodes.rationale: Plugin-owned classes replace inline colors and core .description so styling comes from the plugin stylesheet.

nodes.label: Admin notice view
nodes.rationale: Plugin-owned markup, no core .notice class (avoids inheriting changing admin CSS). No dismiss button: bootstrap notices (no engine, assets not built) stay true after dismissal; transient feedback is a toast.

nodes.label: build-dist.sh distribution build
nodes.rationale: Builds org-ready zip: npm build, composer autoloader (no deps; vendor ships since WP.org runs no build), rsync excludes, then fails on unexpected top-level entries because the exclude list went stale before. Warns not to install the zip over the git working tree.

nodes.label: REST namespace omnio-image-optimizer/v1
nodes.rationale: rest_namespace + rest_version are load-bearing: the admin bundle calls these URLs.

nodes.label: Hook prefix omnio_io/
nodes.rationale: Every do_action/apply_filters the plugin owns is prefixed with this.

nodes.label: config/optimizer.php (optimizer defaults and bounds)
nodes.rationale: Intended single source for StoreSettings defaults/sanitize bounds and the admin UI, but StoreSettings never reads it; editing it changes nothing at runtime and needs a matching edit in StoreSettings.

nodes.label: Scan frequencies (manual/daily/weekly/monthly)
nodes.rationale: 'monthly' maps to a custom 30-day cron interval; the others are core's.

nodes.label: SCHEMA_VERSION = 3 (omnio_io_schema_version)
nodes.rationale: 2 added conversion_ms; 3 added the URL lookup table backing the 404 fallback.

nodes.label: DBMigrator::runBackfills()
nodes.rationale: Guarded on installed > 0 so a fresh install never runs backfills.

nodes.label: DataBackfills::backfillUrls()
nodes.rationale: Sites upgrading from schema 2 only have old URLs in the log url_map column; without backfill the 404 fallback would silently break.

nodes.label: Application::__construct() boot sequence
nodes.rationale: Order matters: facade must point at the instance before bindings.php runs, and service bindings must exist before hook manifests resolve from the container.

nodes.label: Router::makeCallback() (lazy controller)
nodes.rationale: Controller resolved lazily so nothing is constructed for routes the request never reaches.

nodes.label: Router::makePermissionCallback()
nodes.rationale: A route without a policy is a mistake, not a public endpoint: deny by default (return false).

nodes.label: View::resolve() (realpath containment)
nodes.rationale: realpath + root prefix check keeps a future caller from walking out of the views root.

nodes.label: Shared scan snapshot state
nodes.rationale: One snapshot shared by hero and Bulk tab so figures cannot contradict each other (replaced live mime count + log aggregate). null = never scanned, rather than an unsupported zero.

nodes.label: Lifted settings state
nodes.rationale: Lives in App because Troubleshoot tab also writes a setting and both must send the complete object.

nodes.label: BulkPage.absorb()
nodes.rationale: Snapshot travels in the same response as run state so ring and progress bar describe the same instant.

nodes.label: BulkPage.pumpScan()
nodes.rationale: Drives scan batches while a tab is open; scan-locked/not-scanning errors mean cron or another tab took the batch and are not failures.

nodes.label: BulkPage.startOptimize()
nodes.rationale: Pumps leading scan, conversions, closing scan; the server owns transitions, client calls only make stages finish sooner than cron.

nodes.label: TroubleshootPage.toggleLogging()
nodes.rationale: Sends the whole settings object because the server sanitizer rebuilds from input; a partial save would reset every other value.

nodes.label: Scan snapshot (single source of library figures)
nodes.rationale: One stored snapshot measured against disk replaces the old split between a live mime count and a log-table aggregate, which could never agree.
nodes.norm_label: scan snapshot (single source of library figures)

nodes.label: Client batch pumping alongside WP-Cron
nodes.rationale: Cron advances work only as fast as traffic allows; an open tab pumps batches faster, with a server-side lock preventing overlap.

nodes.label: Library card e2e spec (Unit 12)
nodes.rationale: Credentials from env; skips rather than failing every test with 403 when unset.

nodes.label: Bulk scanner/runner e2e harness
nodes.rationale: Regression net before Unit 11 queue rework; destructive section skipped if real user images are pending.

nodes.label: WP-CLI bulk e2e harness
nodes.rationale: Runs the real wp binary since flag parsing, clamps and WP_CLI::error exit codes were never observed.

nodes.label: Convert/restore round-trip harness
nodes.rationale: Guards the data-loss path: restored file must be byte-identical; never touches pre-existing media.

nodes.label: ForeignNoticeHandler notice-strip suite
nodes.rationale: Uses real WP_Hook/plugin.php because the handler walks $wp_filter; dropping the plugin's own missing-build notice is the critical regression.

nodes.label: run-cli.sh WP-CLI harness launcher
nodes.rationale: Resolves socket/PHP/domain from Local sites.json and proves pairing with option get siteurl before running.

nodes.label: run.sh harness launcher
nodes.rationale: Pins the aRpCXvFUz socket; --web mode runs suites via web-runner.

nodes.label: web-runner.php (php-fpm harness runner)
nodes.rationale: Imagick exists only in php-fpm, so CLI runs silently use cwebp (issue I-2); token-gated, 2-minute one-shot, tests/ excluded from dist.

nodes.label: Composer PSR-4 autoload (no runtime dependencies)
nodes.rationale: vendor/ holds only the generated autoloader and is committed because WordPress.org runs no build step on the destination server.

nodes.label: FluentCart-style layout
nodes.rationale: app/ holds application code only; the kernel lives at its own framework/ root, like FluentCart\Framework. No src/, Providers/, Repositories/, Foundation/ or Http/Admin/.

nodes.label: app/Http/Routes/api.php fluent route DSL
nodes.rationale: Every route needs a policy; a route without one is refused rather than made public.

nodes.label: Plugin rewrites and deletes user media
nodes.rationale: The backup is often the only copy of the original; a bug produces an unrecoverable media library. Drives every hard rule.
nodes.norm_label: plugin rewrites and deletes user media

nodes.label: Research the graph, don't read the tree
nodes.rationale: One graph query costs a fraction of reading files; caught that the I-10 notice belonged to Elementor.
nodes.norm_label: research the graph, don't read the tree

nodes.label: wordpress-pro skill scoped to WordPress API
nodes.rationale: It assumes a conventional plugin; where it disagrees with agent.md, agent.md wins.
nodes.norm_label: wordpress-pro skill scoped to wordpress api

nodes.label: php-pro skill — language guidance only
nodes.rationale: Its PHPStan/PHPUnit/Laravel tooling advice does not apply.

nodes.label: Never global $wpdb — go through app/Models
nodes.rationale: Exceptions: Services/Rewrite/DatabaseRewriter and database/DataBackfills, where serialization-safe multi-table SQL cannot go through a model.

nodes.label: Never delete by glob over a shared directory
nodes.rationale: A glob cleanup already destroyed 54 real user backups.
nodes.norm_label: never delete by glob over a shared directory

nodes.label: Runtime from WordPress, UI is ours
nodes.rationale: Import from @wordpress/element, api-fetch, i18n; never @wordpress/components; build/admin.asset.php must not list wp-components.
nodes.norm_label: runtime from wordpress, ui is ours

nodes.label: Capability + nonce + sanitize + escape on every input handler
nodes.rationale: REST routes, upload MIME handling, WebP paths, cwebp shell-out, backup paths and unserialize are the real attack surface.
nodes.norm_label: capability + nonce + sanitize + escape on every input handler

nodes.label: Environment lies: DB socket and CLI vs web PHP
nodes.rationale: Both produced confidently-reported fictional findings.
nodes.norm_label: environment lies: db socket and cli vs web php

nodes.label: Plugin Check is the release gate
nodes.rationale: Plugin Check runs its own ruleset and honours only inline phpcs:ignore; phpcs.xml.dist kept narrow to mirror it.
nodes.norm_label: plugin check is the release gate

nodes.label: Never install the built zip over the working tree
nodes.rationale: WordPress deletes the existing folder before unpacking; doing it once destroyed .git, context/, tests/ etc.
nodes.norm_label: never install the built zip over the working tree

nodes.label: PHP 7.4+ / WP 6.2+ floor
nodes.rationale: No enums, readonly, constructor promotion or never; PHPCompatibilityWP fails the build.

nodes.label: tests/php/run.sh rewriter-test
nodes.rationale: Required before and after any change to Rewrite/, Backup/ or AttachmentConverter; guards serialization invariants.

nodes.label: Individual and bulk optimization of existing library
nodes.norm_label: individual and bulk optimization of existing library

nodes.label: Backup retention
nodes.rationale: Backing up uploaded originals roughly doubles upload space until retention passes.

nodes.label: Old image URLs served the new file
nodes.norm_label: old image urls served the new file

nodes.label: Activity log (capped 10MB)
nodes.rationale: Failures always recorded even with logging off so evidence survives.

nodes.label: Skip when WebP would be larger
nodes.norm_label: skip when webp would be larger

nodes.label: 2026-08-08 glob backup deletion incident
nodes.rationale: A harness glob over BackupManager::root() deleted 54 backups / 228 originals; why purge_orphans() is fenced.

nodes.label: Every Local database is named local
nodes.rationale: Wrong socket pairs one site's files with another's DB; produced the fictional '496 orphaned attachments' finding.
nodes.norm_label: every local database is named local

nodes.label: CLI PHP vs web PHP extensions
nodes.rationale: CLI lacks Imagick so harnesses exercise cwebp while users get Imagick.
nodes.norm_label: cli php vs web php extensions

nodes.label: Standalone PHP harnesses (tests/php/)
nodes.rationale: No PHPUnit; harnesses are committed because two scratchpad ones were lost.

nodes.label: cli-bulk-e2e.php
nodes.rationale: Kept out of default suite because optimize --all and restore --all act on the whole library.

nodes.label: Never capture-and-restore settings in harnesses
nodes.rationale: A crashed run leaves dirty values that would be faithfully restored.

nodes.label: Optimizer
nodes.rationale: Never touches the database or attachments; shared by upload and bulk paths with different DB semantics (invariant 5).

nodes.label: AttachmentConverter::soft_errors() (PERMANENT_SKIPS + RETRYABLE_SKIPS)
nodes.rationale: Duplicated list drifted and reported 496 skips as failures; permanent/retryable split lets requeue return only environment-caused skips.

nodes.label: BackupManager::reconcile()
nodes.rationale: Repair before sweep: rebuilds manifests from files on disk, deletes nothing (invariant 26).

nodes.label: UrlMap
nodes.rationale: with_escaped_slashes() adds JSON-escaped forms so no JSON decoding is needed.

nodes.label: omnio_io_log table
nodes.rationale: One table backs stats, restore, bulk dedupe and the 404 fallback map.

nodes.label: omnio_io_urls table
nodes.rationale: Indexed 404 fallback lookup replacing an unindexable LIKE over LONGTEXT (invariant 20).

nodes.label: Engine selection is a chain, not a choice
nodes.rationale: cwebp cannot rotate, GD cannot decode CMYK; a chain with supports_file() lets a file fall through instead of corrupting.
nodes.norm_label: engine selection is a chain, not a choice

nodes.label: ImagickEngine
nodes.rationale: Leads the chain because it preserves ICC; jpeg:size decode hint makes its memory-estimate exemption safe.

nodes.label: CwebpEngine
nodes.rationale: Declines JPEGs with EXIF orientation != 1; escapes every shell argument; never ships a binary.

nodes.label: Interceptor::handle_sideload()
nodes.rationale: WP 7.1 client-side media processing posts each size to /sideload; converts without backing up or parking (invariant 28).

nodes.label: Interceptor::already_belongs_to_an_attachment()
nodes.rationale: Resolving by name is the whole test; fails closed (invariant 27).

nodes.label: Services\Bulk\Runner
nodes.rationale: Persists pending_rewrite before applying (invariant 23) and merges maps to rewrite once per batch.

nodes.label: ScanRunner
nodes.rationale: Library scan observes, never writes to the log table (invariant 25).

nodes.label: Services\Lock
nodes.rationale: Cross-request locks via add_option(), not transients (invariant 18).

nodes.label: Never str_replace over serialized data; use strtr
nodes.rationale: Serialization embeds byte lengths; strtr applies longest key first and never re-scans (invariants 1-3).
nodes.norm_label: never str_replace over serialized data; use strtr

nodes.label: Back up before destructive op, roll back on failure
nodes.rationale: Invariant 4 and 6: failure mid-way must leave a working site.
nodes.norm_label: back up before destructive op, roll back on failure

nodes.label: Memory estimate before decoding
nodes.rationale: Only for in-process engines (GD), after wp_raise_memory_limit; second frame charged at max_dimension size (invariant 7).

nodes.label: A column describing a file is not evidence the file exists
nodes.rationale: Invariant 22: DB and uploads can be restored from different points in time.
nodes.norm_label: a column describing a file is not evidence the file exists

nodes.label: CwebpEngine
nodes.rationale: Bundles nothing; checks exec availability and a binary, steps aside silently - bundling a binary would fail .org review

nodes.label: ImagickEngine
nodes.rationale: Leads the engine chain because it is the only engine that can preserve an ICC profile

nodes.label: omnio_io_log table
nodes.rationale: One table carries stats, restore data, bulk dedupe state and the 404 URL map; a queue table was rejected because Scanner gets the same result via LEFT JOIN and one table is one migration

nodes.label: RetentionCron
nodes.rationale: Historical name; became App\Hooks\Scheduler\JobRunner and no longer exists in code

nodes.label: safe_path()
nodes.rationale: Resolves with realpath() and refuses anything outside the backup root; relative_dir comes from the DB and restore writes files, so it is a traversal vector

nodes.label: AttachmentConverter::SOFT_ERRORS
nodes.rationale: Single definition of 'nothing to do' error codes; no-engine deliberately excluded because it is a real environment problem. Do not re-inline anywhere

nodes.label: Bulk Scanner
nodes.rationale: LEFT JOIN chosen over NOT IN subquery (degrades as log grows) and an upfront ID list (large option, no resumability); paging by ID > cursor, never OFFSET

nodes.label: Logger
nodes.rationale: Static and dependency-free because it is called from upload, cron, WP-CLI and REST where the container may not exist; never touches the database since a broken conversion may be mid-modifying it

nodes.label: Support Lock
nodes.rationale: Uses add_option() so the options table's unique key makes the insert atomic, replacing check-then-set transient locks

nodes.label: reverse_map()
nodes.rationale: Replaces array_flip() and drops non-unique target pairs, which are UrlMap's deliberate fallbacks with no correct inverse

nodes.label: ForeignNoticeHandler
nodes.rationale: Whitelist rather than remove_all_actions so MenuHandler::missing_build_notice survives - when the bundle is missing that notice is the only thing between the user and a blank page

nodes.label: notice-strip-test.php
nodes.rationale: Runs against WordPress's real WP_Hook rather than a stub because the handler is an assertion about how WP_Hook stores callbacks

nodes.label: MimeReconciler
nodes.rationale: Modeled on BackupManager::reconcile()'s read log + disk, write corrections, delete nothing pattern

nodes.label: BackupManager::reconcile()
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds manifests from log rows rather than a directory walk, keeping blast radius at one attachment; writes pointers and deletes nothing

nodes.label: cli-bulk-e2e.php
nodes.rationale: Shells out to the real wp binary because the untested part was flag parsing, clamps and exit codes, which do not exist when calling methods directly

nodes.label: phpcs.xml.dist
nodes.rationale: Narrowed to exactly the three exclusions Plugin Check applies; Plugin Check never reads this file, so a blanket exclude only hid broken inline suppressions

nodes.label: Automatic stop after N consecutive failures
nodes.norm_label: automatic stop after n consecutive failures

nodes.label: Mandatory dry run gate
nodes.rationale: Matters more once unattended scheduled scans exist, since running destructive conversions unattended is a materially different risk profile

nodes.rationale: WP-Cron only fires on site visits; a run can stall for days and the UI must say so rather than show a frozen bar

nodes.label: Action Scheduler
nodes.rationale: Consider where WooCommerce provides it, but never add as a dependency

nodes.label: No fixed 5-minute interval
nodes.rationale: BulkJobRunner re-arms a single event per batch because batch size is adaptive; a fixed interval would idle or lag

nodes.label: Engine preference Imagick > cwebp > GD
nodes.rationale: Imagick preserves ICC; cwebp above GD because it preserves ICC via -metadata icc even though GD was faster in benchmarks

nodes.label: Hand-rolled autoloader, no Composer
nodes.rationale: Zero runtime dependencies; later superseded by Composer PSR-4 in the 2026-08-10 restructure

nodes.label: Upload conversion at wp_handle_upload
nodes.rationale: Fires after file move but before wp_insert_attachment, so WordPress creates a native WebP attachment and every subsize itself; nothing references the file yet so no URL rewriting is needed

nodes.rationale: Applies longest key first and never rescans substituted text
